title: fix(metadata-protocol): the bare layered read serves a member's declared override as effective
body:

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbNTugWasvhTMrtCZiFGrZYK)_

Part of #32849 (the bare layered read's `effective` exit; the read naming no member, measured below, stays open on #32849)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

**#33885 has merged.** This branch started from `claude/area-E1-32622`. After #33885 merged, `origin/main` was merged in (`c9112d29`), so the diff is now this PR's own four files (+125/−7). The own-diff patch-id `c0f3f1897e73032813735aa937738d8e0c8780a6` is unchanged.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:App 的 `.custom` pair 存了一行声明覆盖附加包 Z 自有成员 `fr-FR` 的邮件模板(`overrides.package: Z`)。#33815 之后普通裸读已给出覆盖,但不带包的分层读 `?member=fr-FR&layers=true` 的 `effective` 仍是 Z 原版 `zeta fr-FR`、`overlay` 为空;现在它与 `?package=Z` 一致:`code` 是 Z 原版,`overlay` 和 `effective` 是覆盖,信封指向 Z。
- 为什么改:分层读的 `effective` 定义为「普通读会返回的内容」,声明了的覆盖应在每个给出 Z 该成员的出口被服务(ADR-0146 D8 第 2 项、ADR-0150 D4);Studio 编辑器读的正是这个出口。
- 风险与回滚:只在普通裸读已经改址到 Z 的同一情形下生效(复用同一个判定函数);未声明覆盖、声明给 X 的行(仍 409)、X 自己的 `en-US`、待发布草稿层均不变(已钉)。回滚即还原本 PR,存储数据不变。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts` 中 `declaredOverrideAt` 与 `draftPackageId` 两处。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts -t 'the bare layered read serves'`,预期 6 条全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Own files (four): `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-face.ts` (one `export` keyword and one docblock sentence, no behaviour), `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`, `.changeset/32849-bare-layered-read-declared-override.md`. No `protocol.ts` edit.

`getMetaItemLayered`, naming no package and judged neither served nor refused by `servedAddressJudgment`, now asks `declaredMemberOverrideAddressOf` (the one predicate the plain read uses since #33815, exported from the item face for this). When it names the member's one enabled shipper Z, the read takes Z's address for its layers, as the plain read does, so `effective` is the override `?package=Z` serves.

The pending draft layer (`withDraft`, the Studio door) is not moved: it stays at the address the strict draft read takes (`strictDraftReadAddress`), because the plain read's strict draft read is outside the arm too. Re-addressing it would have made the draft layer `null` where the strict draft read serves the pair's draft (measured: at `?package=Z` the draft layer is `null`).

| read (both install orders) | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| bare `?member=fr-FR&layers=true`, row declares Z | code `zeta fr-FR`, overlay null, effective `zeta fr-FR` | code `zeta fr-FR`, overlay `pair fr-FR`, effective `pair fr-FR`, envelope Z (= `?package=Z`) |
| same, with drafts, a pair draft pending | draft `pair fr-FR draft` | unchanged (effective as above) |
| `?package=Z&member=fr-FR&layers=true` | effective `pair fr-FR` | unchanged |
| bare `?member=en-US&layers=true` (X's own) | `suitex en-US` | unchanged |
| bare, no row / undeclared pair row | effective `zeta fr-FR`, overlay null | unchanged |
| bare, row declares X (#32606 shape) | 409 naming X and Z | unchanged |
| door step 1c, `packagelessLayeredReadRefusal` | no refusal | unchanged |

Nothing refused becomes served or the reverse; no authorable key or value moves.

## Tests

New top-level describe in the shared real-`SchemaRegistry` harness `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`: `[#32849] the bare layered read serves the pair's declared override of an addition Z's own locale as effective, as ?package=Z does` (6 tests):

- fix pin, both install orders: bare layers equal `?package=Z`'s (`effective` deep-equals the `?package=Z` document), step 1c refuses nothing, `effective` equals the plain bare read, X's `en-US` untouched.
- draft pin: the draft layer is the strict draft read's (`pair fr-FR draft`), `?package=Z` has none.
- CONTROL no override x2 (no row / undeclared pair row): Z's own, no overlay.
- CONTROL row declares X: 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming X and Z.

BASE measured on `e516f353` (the #33885 head) with a temporary probe in this harness before any edit: bare effective `zeta fr-FR`, overlay null, in both orders; `?package=Z` effective `pair fr-FR`.

<details><summary>Ablations (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, metadata-protocol rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight` marker present in 2 dist files, auto-restore blob equals HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty, rebuilt, marker absent from all 24 dist files)</summary>

| | mutation | result (`-t 'the bare layered read serves'`) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | the arm's call replaced by `undefined` | 3 failed, 3 passed: both fix pins, `expected [ 'zeta fr-FR', null, …(2) ] to deeply equal [ 'zeta fr-FR', 'pair fr-FR', …(2) ]`; the draft pin, `expected [ 'zeta fr-FR', 'pair fr-FR draft' ] to deeply equal [ 'pair fr-FR', 'pair fr-FR draft' ]` |
| A2 | `isServedOverrideRowOf(row, shipper, installed)` replaced by `true` | 2 failed, 4 passed: the undeclared-row CONTROL, `expected [ 'zeta fr-FR', 'pair fr-FR', …(2) ] to deeply equal [ 'zeta fr-FR', null, …(2) ]`; the X-declared CONTROL, `the read answered; a refusal was expected` |
| A4 | the draft address re-addressed with the arm (`declaredOverrideAt ?? request.packageId`) | 1 failed, 5 passed: the draft pin, `expected [ 'pair fr-FR', null ] to deeply equal [ 'pair fr-FR', 'pair fr-FR draft' ]` |

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The no-row CONTROL pins an unchanged outcome by construction: re-addressed to Z, Z's exact layers with no row answer Z's own `fr-FR` too. The undeclared-row CONTROL is the one that catches an arm ignoring the declaration (A2).
- Still open on #32849, measured on `e516f353` with the same probe (X ships `fr-FR`, Z ships `en-US`, the pair row declares Z for `en-US`): the read naming NO member serves Z's `zeta en-US`, both the plain bare read and the bare layered read, while the bare layered member read `?member=en-US` takes the override after this change. `/published` calls the layered read with no member (`meta-item-history-routes.ts`), so it reads that same exit; not measured at the door. The helper answers `undefined` when no member is named; that exit lives in the item face first and is left to the card.
- Measured through the protocol with a real `SchemaRegistry`, stored rows and hydrated rows (the #33815 footing), not through the HTTP save door; the door's own step 1c is pinned at the protocol.
